text: Provides sandbox merchant accounts to create and verify checkouts before going live
quote: Create and verify a checkout with a sandbox merchant account.

text: Lets developers set up a merchant account, device, and integration specifically for testing
quote: Prepare a merchant account, device, and integration for testing.

text: Sandbox supports test cards to simulate successful, failed, and 3D Secure payment scenarios
quote: SumUp provides sandbox merchant accounts and a comprehensive set of test cards to simulate various payment scenarios, including different 3D Secure authentication flows.

text: Ships documentation aimed at giving coding assistants/agents up-to-date reference material
quote: Give coding assistants current SumUp documentation and tools.

text: All documentation is available as plain-text Markdown by appending index.md to any doc URL
quote: You can access all of our documentation as plain text Markdown files by adding index.md to the end of any URL.

text: Offers three integration paths for in-person payments: Cloud API, Reader SDKs, and Payment Switch
quote: There are three ways to integrate SumUp in-person payments: | | Cloud API | Reader SDKs | Payment Switch |

text: Can trigger and manage payments on Solo/Go card readers via HTTPS requests from a backend
quote: Trigger and manage payments on Solo or Go readers via HTTPS requests.

text: Supports running simultaneous transactions across multiple Solo readers with no distance limit to the POS device
quote: Ability to process simultaneous transactions on multiple Solo card readers at once - No distance limitation between your POS device and the Solo card reader

text: Virtual Solo reader plus sandbox account lets developers test pairing and checkout flow before using a physical reader
quote: Use Virtual Solo together with a sandbox merchant account to test the pairing and checkout flow first, then switch to a physical reader later

text: Tap to Pay lets merchants accept contactless payments directly on a compatible phone with no separate reader
quote: Tap to Pay lets merchants accept in-person contactless payments directly on a compatible phone without carrying a separate card reader.

text: Offline Transactions allow continued card payment acceptance when internet connectivity is unavailable or unreliable
quote: Offline Transactions let merchants continue accepting card payments when internet connectivity is unavailable or unreliable.

text: Runs a managed MCP server so MCP clients can manage accounts, create checkouts, and process payments
quote: SumUp runs a managed MCP server at https://mcp.sumup.com/mcp. This endpoint allows your MCP client to interact with SumUp APIs to manage your account, create checkouts, or process payments

text: Agent Toolkit adds SumUp API tools to agentic apps built with LangChain, AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, or MCP
quote: The SumUp Agent Toolkit adds SumUp API tools to agentic applications built with LangChain, AI SDK, the OpenAI Agents SDK, or the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

text: Provides an API client/SDK to programmatically create checkouts (e.g. amount, reference, currency)
quote: const checkout = await client.checkouts.create({ amount: 2500, checkout_reference: "ORDER-1001", currency: "EUR"

text: Uses static API keys that let an application act on behalf of the merchant account that created them
quote: API keys are static credentials that let your application act on behalf of the merchant account that created the key.

text: Merchants can get notified when a checkout's status changes
quote: At this time our system only allows you to get notified about a status change for a checkout.

text: Payments previously processed can be refunded partially or in full
quote: When you complete these steps, the payment you have previously processed through SumUp will be refunded either partially or in full.

text: Offers multiple checkout integration types to compare: hosted, embedded, web, and mobile
quote: Compare hosted, embedded, web, and mobile checkout options.

text: Payment acceptance can be embedded directly into a merchant's own Android or iOS app
quote: Embed payment acceptance directly in your Android or iOS app.

text: Official @sumup/sdk package wraps the API with TypeScript types for modern JavaScript runtimes
quote: The @sumup/sdk package wraps SumUp API, ships TypeScript declarations, and works in modern JavaScript runtimes and platforms

text: Docs describe methods available to a merchant and checkout for API exploration

text: In-person payment products accept card payments face-to-face via physical readers or Tap to Pay
quote: SumUp's in-person payment products let you accept card payments face-to-face using physical card readers or Tap to Pay on a mobile device.

text: No monthly minimums or hidden fees on the pricing plans
quote: You’ll never pay monthly minimums or hidden fees – ever.

text: Higher-tier plan adds customer rewards, automated marketing, and monthly promotions beyond POS
quote: Everything the POS offers plus customer rewards, automated marketing, and 2 monthly promotions.
